I am a geotechnical engineer with a theoretical and practical background, specialized in
soil and rock mechanics, the behavior of fractured rock media, numerical modeling, dam
engineering and foundation engineering. Since 2023 I have worked in Belo Horizonte, Brazil,
at [DF+ Engenharia](https://dfmais.eng.br), where I lead the geotechnical design of
critical mining structures — tailings dams, dam raisings, waste piles, stockpiles and dry
stacking facilities — across their life cycle, from conceptual studies to executive design
and closure.

In parallel, I am a doctoral candidate at the Graduate Program in Civil Engineering
([PPGEC](https://www.ufrgs.br/ppgec/)) of the Federal University of Rio Grande do Sul
([UFRGS](https://www.ufrgs.br)), under the supervision of Prof. Samir Maghous, working on
the micromechanical formulation of the poroelastic behavior of jointed rock media and its
finite element implementation. My work combines three things I enjoy in equal measure:
deriving models from the mechanics of the constituents, implementing them in codes that
others can use, and confronting them with what is measured in the field.

## Experience

- **Senior Geotechnical Engineer**, [DF+ Engenharia](https://dfmais.eng.br), Belo
  Horizonte — since October 2023. Lead of geotechnical design for waste and stockpile
  facilities and dry stacking, in conceptual, basic and executive phases and under
  diverse climatic settings; design team lead for the downstream raise of a large tailings
  dam, with emphasis on construction-phase engineering support; design of dry stacking and
  soil and rock waste facilities for gold and iron mining, for throughputs up to 11 Mt/y
  and final stack heights above 300 m. Direction of instrumentation and monitoring
  programs, interpretation of advanced field and laboratory tests, borrow area studies,
  as-built documentation, technical review of design deliverables and direct interface
  with clients.
- **Geotechnical Engineer**, TPF Engenharia, Belo Horizonte — March to October 2023.
  Safety monitoring of 29 tailings storage facilities as part of the Engineer of Record
  team: monthly performance reports, regular safety inspection reports, stability
  analyses, design reviews and consolidation of geotechnical parameters.
- **Geotechnical Engineer**, Solution IPD, Porto Alegre and Curitiba — March 2022 to
  March 2023. FEL 2 studies of foundation systems for large pulp and paper plants, slope
  stability reports for natural and engineered slopes, and foundations for unconventional
  structures, including massive industrial plants and vibrating equipment (dynamic
  analysis).
- **Research Fellow**, UFRGS, Porto Alegre — 2017 to 2023. Researcher at the Center for
  Applied and Computational Mechanics (CEMACOM) and member of the research project
  *Poromechanical approach to the analysis and interpretation of geotechnical tests*,
  coordinated by Prof. Samir Maghous, with CNPq scholarships during the master's and the
  doctorate.
- **Geotechnical Engineering Intern**, Luiz Englert Foundation / LAGEOtec, Porto
  Alegre — 2015 to 2016. Conceptual and basic design of de-watered mining tailings piles
  and dams, under the supervision of Prof. Luiz Antônio Bressani.

## Education

- **Ph.D. in Civil Engineering (Geotechnics)**, UFRGS — in progress since 2019, with a
  leave of absence in 2023–2025. Thesis *Micromechanical formulation of the poroelastic
  behavior of jointed rock media and computational implementation*, advised by
  Prof. Samir Maghous. CNPq scholarship.
- **M.Sc. in Civil Engineering (Geotechnics)**, UFRGS, 2019. Thesis *Analysis of the
  effects of residual stresses on bored piles: a computational approach*, advised by
  Prof. Samir Maghous and Prof. Renato Vaz Linn. CNPq scholarship.
- **B.Sc. in Civil Engineering**, UFRGS, 2016. Undergraduate thesis on the maintenance
  method and the local materials of unpaved roads in the municipality of Maquiné (RS),
  advised by Prof. Washington Peres Núñez.

## Teaching and outreach

- Short course *Elements of algebra and tensor analysis for continuum mechanics*

- Co-organizer of the lecture and short-course series for the 50th anniversary of
  PPGEC, 2020.
- Physics teacher in community pre-university courses: Centro dos Estudantes

- Online courses in physics, vector mechanics, strength of materials and mathematics for

## Service
